name: Message And Business Reference 14
definition: Information about the message reference of the message for which the status is requested and the business reference of the transfer instruction.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: Reference to the message or communication that was previously sent.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual transfers as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual transfers together.

TransferReference.name: Transfer Reference
TransferReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the transfer, as assigned by the instructing party.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of the transfer. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the transfer as assigned by the underlying client.

CancellationReference.name: Cancellation Reference
CancellationReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a transfer cancellation, as assigned by the instructing party.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Investment account information of the transfer for which the status or information is requested.

IntermediaryInformation.name: Intermediary Information
IntermediaryInformation.definition: Identification of a related party or intermediary.

RequestIssuer.name: Request Issuer
RequestIssuer.definition: Party that issues the request message.

RequestRecipient.name: Request Recipient
RequestRecipient.definition: Party that receives the request message.

OtherReferenceRule.definition: Reference/OtherReference should be used to reference a transfer instruction or a transfer cancellation request 'message' sent in a proprietary way or used for a system reference. If Reference/OtherReference is present, Reference/OtherReference/MessageName must contain 'fax' or 'phone' or 'email', etc.

PreviousReferenceRule.definition: If Reference/PreviousReference/MessageName is present, it must start with sese.001, sese.002, sese.005, sese.006, sese.012 or sese.014.
